answer: Registration binds each identity to a 400-unit bond escrowed against one hardware credential and a proof-of-work record logged once per device, with each comet tag hashed into the registry. Forging N identities locks 400N units, risks 100 percent slashing of every bond, and requires waiting 30 epochs per credential. Splitting identities yields no discount, since the marginal cost per fake stays 400 units and independent jurors trace shared nectar and hollow device fingerprints.
